name: edupage
description: EduPage school data (timetables, grades, homework, meals, messages) plus a school-day-summary agent skill.

edupage_username.title: EduPage username
edupage_username.description: Your EduPage login (parent account). Also accepted as the EDUPAGE_USERNAME environment variable.

edupage_password.title: EduPage password
edupage_password.description: Your EduPage password. Stored in the platform's secure credential store, never in settings.json. Also accepted as the EDUPAGE_PASSWORD environment variable.

edupage_subdomains.title: School subdomains (optional)
edupage_subdomains.description: Comma-separated EduPage school subdomains, e.g. myschool,myschool-gym. Leave empty to let the server auto-discover. Also accepted as the EDUPAGE_SUBDOMAINS environment variable.
